newsitem.title: USA: Disney names Boyd chairman of Consumer Products.
newsitem.headline: Disney names Boyd chairman of Consumer Products.

text.p: Walt Disney Co Monday promoted Barton Boyd to the newly-created position of chairman of Disney Consumer Products, the division responsible for worldwide merchandise licensing and the fast-growing chain of Disney stores.
In a statement, Disney said Boyd had been president of the division since 1985.
Disney also promoted Anne Osberg to president, Disney Consumer Products Worldwide. She will continue to report to Boyd.

Prior to her promotion, Osberg was president, U.S. and Canada Operations, a $7 billion business at retail. Osberg's new duties include worldwide licensing and merchandising, Disney Interactive, Disney Publishing, The Disney Store and global business development.
